verdict.rationale: Goodwin's Founders Workbench ships software tools (Document Driver, Capital Calculator, Liquidation Calculator), so whether their source is readable under an open license is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence shows any published source code or open license. 'Free' tools are not open source, and the Open Source Software page describes legal advisory services, not Goodwin's own code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
